g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a
first practice session, so interest turns into sustained practice. |
Nobody feels recruited or pressured; Organisers' hours stay as they are |
What actually happened? Report what you did and what you observed,
with numbers and the period if you have them.
